events.title: Imagine album turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album "Imagine" was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine 51st Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine', an album that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity.

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Musician Sting, born Gordon Matthew Thomas Sumner, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Sting's 75th Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legend that is Sting! From The Police to his incredible solo career, he's given us some unforgettable tunes.

events.title: iPod launched 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod to the world on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod 25th Anniversary
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago today, Apple dropped the original iPod, a game-changer that revolutionised how we listened to music.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, commemorating the release of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Today we celebrate 007 and all the iconic films, gadgets, and theme tunes that have kept us shaken, not stirred, for decades.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Iconic musician John Lennon, born in Liverpool on October 9, 1940, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon's 86th Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Today, we remember the legendary John Lennon, who would have been 86. His timeless music and powerful messages continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Actor and comedian John Cleese, born October 27, 1939, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese's 87th Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! A true master of British comedy, from Python to Fawlty Towers.

events.title: The White Album turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking "White Album" was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album 58th Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles gave us the iconic 'White Album', a double LP packed with some of their most diverse and memorable tracks.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who died on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury today. His voice, his stage presence, and his music with Queen remain truly iconic.

events.title: Rubber Soul turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album "Rubber Soul" was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul 61st Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that marked a pivotal shift in their sound and songwriting.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of music legend John Lennon, who died on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day, we pause to remember John Lennon, a visionary artist whose impact on music and culture continues to be felt worldwide.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary artist David Bowie, born David Robert Jones on January 8, 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: David Bowie's 80th Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Today, we celebrate the enduring legacy of David Bowie, who would have been 80. A true innovator, his music and style continue to inspire.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, born January 8, 1935, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis Presley's 92nd Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we remember the King, Elvis Presley. His music and charisma changed the world forever.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page, born January 9, 1944, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jimmy Page's 83rd Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The guitar maestro behind some of Led Zeppelin's most iconic riffs.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rock and pop icon Rod Stewart, born January 10, 1945, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod Stewart's 82nd Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Rod Stewart! From rock anthems to timeless ballads, his career has been nothing short of spectacular.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson), born January 13, 1961, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs' 66th Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness! Here's to more 'Our House' moments and timeless ska tunes.
